paper_id: LoRA-C_ Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Robust CNN for IoT Devices
title: LoRA-C: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Robust CNN for IoT Devices
motivation: IoT设备部署在恶劣环境中处理受环境干扰的数据,需要高效提升CNN鲁棒性
problem_framing: 将LoRA从Transformer迁移到CNN时,核参数共享特性导致kernel-wise方法参数膨胀,需重新设计分解粒度
key_insight: 采用layer-wise低秩分解替代kernel-wise,并发现α/r保持常数(≈2)时性能最优
method_signature: LoRA-C在卷积层引入矩阵A(r×cin×k)和B(cout×k×r),仅更新约1%参数
evaluation_criteria: CIFAR-10/100准确率、CIFAR-10-C鲁棒性、Icons-50风格泛化、参数量减少率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: kernel-wise方法在r≥k时参数量超过全微调,难以平衡性能与参数效率
evidence_for_taste: kernel-wise will be greater than the full fine-tuning one when r ≥ k
the best performance is usually obtained when α/r is a constant
the gap in accuracy between the two settings is narrowing
it is not the case that the more parameters updated, the better
thinking_moves: 将Transformer中LoRA的分解机制适配到CNN卷积层结构
通过数学推导比较kernel-wise与layer-wise的参数效率
从参数比与准确率的关系发现α/r常数的经验法则
根据模型容量(参数量)自动选择rank设置策略
